about: BUN3 (A): real regressions in the tail of Bun's port (oven-sh/bun#30412), hand-sorted by qb5 on 2026-10-12 from 64 candidate commits (subjects matching fix-build words, or naming a culprit commit as dropped/reverted/removed/lost by). strict = the fix names its culprit and the message says something was lost or broken; borderline = a real build fix with no named culprit (culprit = the latest earlier tail commit sharing a file) or an unclear naming. compileDetectable = a cargo check of the touched crate would have failed on the culprit. Excluded (53): "no source fix" test notes (debug-build slowness), compiler-warning cleanups, fixes of port bugs with no earlier culprit, test fixture tuning.
